text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Embeddings service: elevated error rate (18% 1m) for embedding-create endpoint. Paging eng-oncall and eng-ml. Pager: @maya

maya: i'm on it — looking at the envoy and runtime logs now. seeing 503s from embedder runtime and a backlog of queued requests.

maya: quick snapshot from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-14T03:12:07Z embed-runtime ERROR failed_to_serve_batch request_id=ab12 status=503 model=embed-large queue_ms=1240
2026-03-14T03:12:09Z embed-runtime WARN batch_truncation model=embed-large batch_size=128->64 reasons=oom
```

raj: i'm awake, will join. any config changes recently?

maya: not in prod deploys. we did flip EMBED_CACHE_PREFETCH on staging last night but not prod. suspect load spike + model OOMs.

kevin: i'll try scaling pool and enable small-model fallback. executing scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment/embed-runtime --replicas=6 -n inference`

ops-runbook-bot: runbook step executed: scaled embed-runtime -> 6 replicas (command by kevin). Next step: enable fallback.

kevin: enabled runtime flag USE_SMALL_EMBED_FALLBACK=true for service-id embed-runtime via config service.

maya: enabling token-bucket limiter at edge to reduce retries hammering runtime: set rate_limit=40rps per-tenant using feature-flag. applied.

alisa: CS update: 8 paying customers reported slow / failed embeddings, some with degraded latency. alerted highest-usage customers and opened support cases.

raj: seeing queue drain after scaling + fallback enabled. errors down to ~1.5% now. good to confirm with canaries.

maya: mitigation summary: 1) scaled replicas, 2) enabled small-model fallback, 3) applied token-bucket limiter, 4) enabled prefix-KV caching for common requests.

kevin: note — root cause hypothesis: model memory pressure at peak batch sizes -> OOMs -> partial batch truncation -> higher latency -> client retries -> queue storms. We'll validate.

maya: handing off to night oncall @raj at 04:00 UTC. Handoff notes: mitigations in place, monitor dashboards linked, if errors >3% for 10m escalate to eng-ml.

maya: created incident channel: #incident-embed-1753204821 and linked runbook.

maya: created postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4902 (please add notes and assign).

raj: i'll own the overnight watch and follow-up tomorrow for root cause.

kevin: action items i'm taking: 1) reproduce OOM locally with load harness (due 2026-03-18), 2) propose model-quantization profile for embed-large (due 2026-03-25).

maya: my action items: 1) update runbook with explicit rate-limiter steps + checklist (PR opened) https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/234 (assign maya), 2) coordinate customer RCA comms with @alisa (due EOD 2026-03-15).

ops-runbook-bot: runbook PR opened by maya: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/234 — reviewers: @kevin @raj.

devx: suggested org-wide learning: brown bag on "Preventing embedding service overloads" covering rate-limiting patterns, caching, and failover. propose two slots: Mon 2026-03-22 16:00 PDT or Wed 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT — poll: https://doodle.com/poll/example

kevin: happy to present the failure-mode testing and quantization tradeoffs. i'll prepare a short lab to show how to reproduce the overload locally.

maya: i'd like to cover the incident timeline and runbook changes in the brown bag. also include ops and CS for customer-impact lessons.

alisa: i'll surface customer-facing postmortem draft in the ticket and invite CS to the brown bag.

raj: for the postmortem: propose timeline sections (detection, mitigation, root cause analysis, impact matrix, action items). i've added a template to the ticket.

maya: retrospective scheduled: Mon 2026-03-16 10:00 UTC (calendar invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-ml, devx, cs). please add any blockers to ENG-4902.

kevin: opened a follow-up tracking board card: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=42&projectKey=ENG — card: "Embed service overload prevention".

maya: final note before handoff: monitor thresholds — error_rate, p95 latency, queue_depth. if queue_depth > 500 or p95 > 1200ms for 5m, escalate immediately.

raj: acknowledged. taking over monitoring. logging link: https://logs.redwood.ai/streams/embed-runtime?from=1753204800

maya: thanks team :thumbsup: — we'll reconvene for the retrospective and brown bag to share learnings and prevention patterns.

devx: posting meeting slides & lab repo after brown bag: https://github.com/redwood/devx/embed-overload-lab

ops-runbook-bot: incident closed in PagerDuty by maya. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maya: closing thread — please add any follow-ups to ENG-4902 and the triage board.
